lenses.name: Alpha adapter interface depth
lenses.guide: Review the provider compaction adapter module after it gained one controller-facing interface. Find one opportunity to make this seam deeper and smaller while preserving all current OpenAI, Azure, and Codex behavior. There is no backward-compatibility requirement. Apply the deletion test to protocol-specific exports, selection helpers, and caller-visible retention or parsing choices. The interface is the test surface; callers should not bypass the capability selection or learn which adapter implements a surface. Prefer deleting alternate routes into the implementation. Do not add an adapter factory, dependency-injection framework, class, new module, or generic transport layer. Report one global interface simplification, not a local parsing defect, naming issue, or formatting concern.
